conviction_note: Small upside lean. The new line on this print is the first FY2027 guide, which management promised on 2026-10-14 'given the strong increase in contracted backlog'. The company's own documents (hyperscaler contract $500-600m, mostly 2027; ~40% of a ~$2B backlog converting within 12-18 months of Aug 2026; year-end backlog 'approaching $3B') point to a 2027 revenue base well above the only consensus figure found (~$306m, one aggregator, unverified). Short interest is ~21% of float with 9.1 days to cover. Against that: the Texas TCEQ data-center permit halt, in force since 2026-09-21, could delay the Texas off-grid project; Q4 must carry about $250m of revenue; and this name has sold prints before (Q1 2026, -16.3%). p_up 55 on abs 17 gives +1.7. impact_sum is +2.9 because the guidance and short-crowding findings are each sized on their own; the gap is the reaction-function discount on p_up, not an inconsistency.
bar: Q3 2026: consensus revenue is disputed ($13.9m Chartmill, $14.8m EarningsWhispers, $17.8m Benzinga EN, $25.1m Benzinga KR) and EPS ranges from -$0.13 to -$0.21 (per a search summary of https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/NRGV/estimates and https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/NRGV; both pages returned 403 to direct fetch). FY2026 company guide is the 'top half' of $270-310m, i.e. $290-310m (https://offshoresource.com/business-wire/energy-vault-schedules-conference-call-to-discuss-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-fy-2026-revenue-guidance-to-the-top-half-of-the-previous-range/, 2026-10-14). FY2027 revenue consensus about $306m from 6 analysts, one aggregator, seen only in a search snippet; one Simply Wall St figure is $413m from 1 analyst. The FY2027 bar is therefore unsourced to two agreeing sources, and the guidance findings are capped. print_vs_bar_pct is the initial FY27 revenue guide against ~$306m, a low-confidence read.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest 32,201,045 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 9.11 days to cover. That is 17.7% of 181.84M shares outstanding and about 21% of float, given insiders hold 17.2% (MarketBeat). It was 33.74M at 09-30 and 29.75M at 06-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/nrgv/shortinterest, read 2026-11-10). Crowded short. The options market has put/call OI 0.33, total OI 88k, and ATM IV 162%. Event-implied move is 16.18%, but the ATM spread is 67% of mid, so it is indicative only. 25-delta skew is null in the baseline, so the market gives no directional statement. The tape shows the stock -47% from its 52-week high, +9.8% over 20 days and +6.4% over 5 days. It fell about 28% in early October (low $2.46) after the 10-14 'raise' and rebounded about 39% off that low. On 11-10 intraday it was $3.425, -5.4% on the day (AAII).

findings.finding: Energy Vault will give its first FY2027 guide on this call (promised 2026-10-14 'given the strong increase in contracted backlog'). Its own documents imply 2027 revenue well above the ~$306m consensus. The 1.25 GW Texas hyperscaler contract is $500-600m 'through the end of 2027', with 'the majority in 2027'. About 40% of the ~$2B backlog at 2026-08-10 (~$800m) converts within 12-18 months. Year-end backlog is expected to 'approach $3B' even after Q4 recognition. Management sees 2027 gross margin holding at 20-25%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance-bearing earnings prints: Q3 2025 (2025-11-10) +20.85%; Q4 2025 (2026-03-17) +2.57%, after a 2026-02-18 preview; Q1 2026 (2026-05-05) -16.3% despite strong revenue growth; Q2 2026 (2026-08-11, FY26 guide raised to $270-310m plus the hyperscaler contract) +9.5%. The 2026-10-14 pre-announced 'top half' raise was followed by roughly -28% in October. Reactions are large and mixed in sign.
findings.why_not_priced: At $3.42 the stock trades about 40% below the $5.76 consensus target, and Citi cut its target from $6.00 to $4.75 on 10-21. Consensus FY27 revenue of ~$306m is barely above FY26's $290-310m guide, which implies near-zero growth despite a $500-600m contract weighted to 2027. If the market priced a 2027 guide of $450m or more, the stock would not have sold off 28% after the FY26 raise, and estimates would not sit flat year over year. The guide is a new number that does not yet exist. The counterweight is that a consensus number from one aggregator may be stale, and the cap reflects that.
findings.independence: Webull call transcript summary (https://www.webull.com/news/15426432943563776, 2026-08-11): the majority of hyperscaler revenue lands in 2027, and the 2027 outlook is 'very encouraging'. The 10-14 release (https://offshoresource.com/business-wire/energy-vault-schedules-conference-call-to-discuss-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-fy-2026-revenue-guidance-to-the-top-half-of-the-previous-range/) chose to pre-commit to a FY27 guide. Both are company-sourced, not independent of the company.

findings.finding: Texas Gov. Abbott's 2026-09-21 directive halted all TCEQ permits for data centers, including air permits for new emission sources, until ERCOT's audit is complete. ERCOT will not present findings until 2026-12-10, and TCEQ shut its automated filing system in late October. Energy Vault's largest contract is a 1.25 GW off-grid Texas hyperscaler project using gas gensets, so the 2027 timing behind the first FY27 guide is exposed. On the Q2 call management said only the August interconnection pause was 'reflected in guidance'; the September expansion came later.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this line. The October drawdown of about 28% came after the 09-21 order and has no other identified cause, but that is inference, not a demonstrated reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock fell sharply in October. The company affirmed FY26 'top half' on 10-14, after the order, so Q4 2026 equipment deliveries appear unaffected. The open question is whether the FY27 guide is haircut or carries a Texas-permit caveat. If fully priced, the guide being reaffirmed would already sit in a recovered price, and the stock remains 47% off its high. Macro-to-company transmission is not confirmed by the company or the customer.
findings.independence: RuntimeWire 2026-09-23 (https://runtimewire.com/article/abbott-texas-data-center-permit-halt-ai-infrastructure): on-site generation is not exempt from TCEQ review. Baker Hostetler 2026-09-23 (https://www.bakerlaw.com/insights/texas-halts-data-center-permitting-pending-state-audits-what-developers-investors-and-energy-users-need-to-know/): the halt reaches 'all state agency approvals'. The counterweight is a Kodiak CEO quote (https://www.enverus.com/blog/texas-data-center-moratorium-big-bark-no-bite/) that the pause benefits behind-the-meter providers. This is a proxy.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 revenue is light by design. The CFO said 'a vast majority of second half revenue is expected to be recognized in the fourth quarter'. With H1 revenue at $39.2m and FY guided to $290-310m, Q3 plus Q4 must deliver about $251-271m. Q3 consensus is $14-25m (disputed), and Q4 must then carry roughly $230-255m, an order of magnitude above any prior quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue of $17.4m beat ~$14.2-14.9m estimates by about 17%, and the stock rose 9.5% the next session. Q1 2026 was roughly in line and the stock fell 16.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q3 number is inside what the company guided, and the FY was reconfirmed on 10-14, so the quarter is pre-determined in aggregate and sized at 0. The risk is optics: any slip of Q4 milestones into 2027 would show up as a FY26 cut, which the 10-14 release makes unlikely five weeks later.
findings.independence: Shares the Q2 call with finding 1. The Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001828536/000182853626000100/ex991_evpressreleasex2026q2.htm) gives H1 revenue of $39.2m.

findings.finding: Financing answered. The 2026-08-14 $137.5m senior secured term loan (EV Gen Set 1, SOFR+6.75%, maturing 2028-01-02) funds power-generation equipment under an Equipment Supply Agreement, drawn as payments come due, which is the hyperscaler ramp. The 2026-09-18 S2G $25m delayed-draw term loan at 10% cash plus 7% PIK funds BESS project acquisitions (the Goshe 2.3 GW portfolio). Cash was $148m including restricted cash at 6-30, and the year-end target is $160-200m. Shares outstanding rose from 169.0M to 179.9M in H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-02-11: a $140m 5.25% convertible offering went with a -23.15% move. Financing events have been sold hard on this name before.
findings.why_not_priced: Both 8-Ks are public. What is not public is the Q3 cash walk against the $160-200m year-end target. A miss on cash would raise the odds of a post-print equity raise, which this name has done before. The genset loan corroborates the Q4 delivery ramp, so the signed sum is about zero: the money buys visible demand, and the 17% all-in S2G cost signals scarce capital.
findings.independence: S2G 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1828536/000182853626000111/nrgv-20260918.htm, filed 2026-09-22). Separate document, same company.

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 2025 print (2025-11-10) moved +20.85% and Q2 2026 +9.5%. Short interest data at those dates was not checked.
findings.why_not_priced: A crowded short with 9 days to cover is a mechanism that acts only on a constructive release. If it were already unwound, short interest would have fallen with the early-November rebound, and the 10-15 to 10-30 estimate is flat at about 33.6M (model, not FINRA).

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and an implied move of about 16% on a 67%-wide spread, so the market states size and not direction. My lean is mildly up, against a stock that sold off after its last pre-announced raise and was down 5.4% intraday on print day. That history is why p_up is 55 and not 60.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6: the FY27 bar (~$306m) has one aggregator source, so the guidance finding was capped from +3.0 to +2.0 and print_vs_bar cut from +15 to +10. The disputed Q3 bar keeps the reported-quarter finding at 0.
Lessons 5 and 7: the Texas permit halt is unconfirmed macro-to-company transmission against a crowded short (~21% of float), so it was shrunk from -1.2 to -1.0 and filed, not dropped.

Lesson 4: asked what the money buys. The genset term loan funds the contracted hyperscaler ramp, so financing moved from 0.0 to +0.2 (zero to small positive), with the expensive S2G loan as the offset.
Lesson 1: this name sold Q1 2026 (-16.3%) and the October raise, so p_up moved from 56 to 55; abs_move unchanged at 17 (first guide on a crowded short, lesson 8).
The analyst-reset finding was trimmed from +0.3 to +0.2 as wire copy.
